gemini.rationale: The slice explicitly states that Calpine's entire operating business, including its generation fleet (T4), wholesale/retail power operations (T5), and headquarters organization (T6), crossed to the Parent as a single unit. Because these components were not separated, there are no structural gaps between product and process (gap_45) or process and organization (gap_56).

grok.rationale: The slice states the entire operating asset base—generation fleet, wholesale/retail power-marketing operations, and associated fuel procurement—crossed to Parent as a whole with Calpine surviving intact, so T4 product and T5 processes moved together (gap_45=0). It likewise records that the headquarters organization crossed as a single unit with the operating business in the reverse triangular merger, and consummation was not contingent on any new Parent employment arrangements, so T5 and T6 aligned at closing (gap_56=0).

openai.rationale: The slice states that Calpine’s entire generation fleet and wholesale/retail power-marketing operations crossed together with the associated fuel-procurement operations, so no product-versus-process mismatch was structured at closing [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-341396, DEFM14A]. It also states that the entire operating business and headquarters organization crossed as a single unit rather than being separated into product, process, and people components; therefore, no process-versus-organization gap is documented, notwithstanding the absence as of the proxy date of separate continuing-employment agreements with Parent [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-341396, DEFM14A].
